title: Local constancy of the sheaf of integral lattices
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, and let $A=\mathcal O_E$ be its valuation ring with the induced $\ell$-adic topology [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. On $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] use the coefficient ring sheaves $A_X(V)=C(|V|,A)$ and $E_X(V)=C(|V|,E)$ of continuous functions. Let $L$ be an $E_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] locally free of finite rank: some pro-etale covering trivializes it to finite sums of $E$, with ranks allowed to vary. For $U\to X$ define $\mathscr L_L(U)$ to be the set of isomorphism classes of pairs $(M,\alpha)$, where $M$ is an $A_U$-module sheaf pro-etale locally free of finite rank and $\alpha:E_U\otimes_{A_U}M\xrightarrow{\sim}L|_U$ is an $E_U$-linear isomorphism [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Two pairs are identified exactly when an $A_U$-linear isomorphism between their modules intertwines their maps $\alpha$; restriction is inverse image on the localized site [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. This presheaf is a sheaf of sets. If $L|_U\cong E_U^n$ for $n\geq0$, then $\mathscr L_L|_U\cong\underline{S_n}_U$, where $S_n=\operatorname{GL}_n(E)/\operatorname{GL}_n(A)$ is the set of right cosets, $\operatorname{GL}_n(R)$ is the group of invertible $n$ by $n$ matrices over $R$, and $\underline{S_n}_U$ is the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value the discrete set $S_n$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. The isomorphism sends $g\operatorname{GL}_n(A)$ to $(gA_U^n,\alpha_g)$, with $\alpha_g$ the scalar-extension isomorphism induced by the inclusion into $E_U^n$.
